target.definition: Number of live births in South Korea during August 2026, as first reported in the national statistics agency's monthly Population Trends release.

inputs.name: annual_births_2025
inputs.description: Total live births in South Korea in calendar year 2025.

provenance.rationale: Recent monthly counts around 20k imply roughly 240k annual births, with a slight recent uptick.

inputs.name: august_share_of_annual_births
inputs.description: Fraction of annual live births that occur in August.

provenance.rationale: August is near the annual average; seasonal share typically 8–9%.

inputs.name: monthly_births_recent
inputs.description: Average monthly live births in South Korea in the most recent months before August 2026.

provenance.rationale: Recent monthly counts have hovered around 20k.

inputs.name: august_seasonal_factor
inputs.description: Multiplicative factor for August relative to an average month.

provenance.rationale: August births are close to average, with modest seasonal variation.

inputs.name: births_per_woman_annual
inputs.description: Annual live births per woman of reproductive age (15–49) in South Korea.

provenance.rationale: Implied by ~240k births and ~7 million women aged 15–49.

inputs.name: women_15_49
inputs.description: Number of women aged 15–49 in South Korea.

provenance.rationale: Approximate size of the reproductive-age female population.

inputs.name: august_fraction_of_year
inputs.description: Fraction of the year represented by August.

provenance.rationale: August has 31 days; 31/366 ≈ 0.0847 for a leap year.

paths.description: Allocate annual births to August using the seasonal share.
Scale recent monthly births by the August seasonal factor.
Estimate from reproductive-age women and per-woman birth rate, prorated to August.

problems: path p2: dimension mismatch: formula gives s**-1, target is dimensionless
path p3: dimension mismatch: formula gives s**-1, target is dimensionless
